workflow_runs.name: HIA finite CRC context and static controls
workflow_runs.display_title: wip(hia): recover and qualify v2 original-artifact chain replay

head_commit.message:
fix(hia): bind scalar replay dependencies and operation requests

Tie conditional plan evidence to its exact plan, both original object hashes and frames; tie encoding rederivation to every stable original build field. Require all seven profile definitions and exact evaluation/adoption/rollback request bindings and order.

Add four independent relationship regressions and raise the focused gate to sixteen tests. Preserve the first recovered head's successful scalar qualification and require this head's own CI. No emitter, linker, native loader or execution authority is added to replay.
